name: Ton Diepeveen - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the decarbonisation and modernisation of EU fisheries, and the development and deployment of fishing gear
part_text:
**What this report asks for**

This report is the European Parliament's opinion, not a new law. It asks the European Union to help fishing crews switch to cleaner energy in a way they can afford. It wants more money and looser rules so boats can be modernised or replaced, and better working and safety conditions on board. It also asks for support to develop new fishing gear that catches fewer unwanted fish and uses less fuel.

**Key points**

- It asks for changes to EU funding rules so public money can help modernise or replace boats.
- It affects fishing crews, especially small-scale and island operators, plus boat builders and ports.
- Next, the European Commission and member states are asked to act; the Parliament itself decides nothing here.
